name: kinemo
tagline: A webcam-only motion game console: two players box, slice flying fruit or race reaction tests with their bodies.
problem: Active games usually need consoles, controllers or VR gear.
solution: Pose tracking from a single webcam drives a gesture-controlled menu and three two-player games, with physics such as projectile modelling and interpolation for smooth motion, and match statistics.
demo_moment: Team-described: two people step in front of a laptop and box each other on screen.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Grew from a boxing tracker into a multi-game console once they saw people enjoy it.
Visitors lined up to play during the event, as the team's photos show.
A demo the judges can physically play beats one they watch.

lessons: If people keep coming back to play your prototype during the event, follow that and make it the product.
